title: California Tennis Club

services.name: Tennis Clinics
services.desc: We offer adult and junior clinics lead by our tennis pros. Our clinics cater to players of all levels, allowing members to grow their skills in a competitive group

services.name: Private Lessons
services.desc: Our pros offer private lessons exclusively to our members, allowing for more focused and personalized instruction. Members can do single or group lessons up to 4 people, ensuring that they receive the focused instruction from our coaches to achieve their tennis
